name: M3_OIS100MI_SearchHead_LimitedOutput
description: This tool can search for customer order head information given many different search criteria.

inputParameters.name: ORNO
inputParameters.description: Customer order number matching the search criteria.

inputParameters.name: ORTP
inputParameters.description: Customer order type controlling processing and default settings for the order.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility responsible for fulfilling the order.

inputParameters.name: ORST
inputParameters.description: Highest line status reached on the order.

inputParameters.name: ORSL
inputParameters.description: Lowest line status among all lines on the order.

inputParameters.name: ORDT
inputParameters.description: Date when the customer order was registered.

inputParameters.name: TIZO
inputParameters.description: Time zone used when interpreting the order’s date and time values.

inputParameters.name: OBLC
inputParameters.description: Stop code indicating whether the order is blocked due to credit or other issues.

inputParameters.name: TEPY
inputParameters.description: Payment terms that determine how invoice due dates are calculated for the order.

inputParameters.name: MODL
inputParameters.description: Delivery method to be used for shipping the order.

inputParameters.name: TEDL
inputParameters.description: Delivery terms agreed with the customer for the order.

inputParameters.name: ADID
inputParameters.description: Delivery address number used for the order.

inputParameters.name: FRE1
inputParameters.description: Customer statistics identity 1 used for reporting on the order.

inputParameters.name: PYNO
inputParameters.description: Payer number that will be invoiced for the order.

inputParameters.name: CUCD
inputParameters.description: Currency used for the order values.

inputParameters.name: NTAM
inputParameters.description: Total net order value excluding charges and tax.

inputParameters.name: RESP
inputParameters.description: User responsible for the order header.

outputParameters.name: ORNO
outputParameters.description: Customer order number matching the search criteria.

outputParameters.name: CUNO
outputParameters.description: Customer number on the order.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility responsible for fulfilling the order.

outputParameters.name: ORTP
outputParameters.description: Customer order type controlling processing and default settings for the order.

outputParameters.name: ORDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the customer order was registered.

outputParameters.name: RESP
outputParameters.description: User responsible for the order header.

outputParameters.name: SMCD
outputParameters.description: Salesperson responsible for the order.

outputParameters.name: ORST
outputParameters.description: Highest line status reached on the order.

outputParameters.name: ORSL
outputParameters.description: Lowest line status among all lines on the order.

outputParameters.name: OBLC
outputParameters.description: Stop code indicating whether the order is blocked due to credit or other issues.

outputParameters.name: NTAM
outputParameters.description: Total net order value excluding charges and tax.

outputParameters.name: CUCD
outputParameters.description: Currency used for the order values.

outputParameters.name: RLDZ
outputParameters.description: Requested delivery date (destination timezone)

outputParameters.name: TIZO
outputParameters.description: Time zone used when interpreting the order’s date and time values.

outputParameters.name: FRE1
outputParameters.description: Customer statistics identity 1 used for reporting on the order.

outputParameters.name: TEPY
outputParameters.description: Payment terms that determine how invoice due dates are calculated for the order.

outputParameters.name: MODL
outputParameters.description: Delivery method to be used for shipping the order.

outputParameters.name: TEDL
outputParameters.description: Delivery terms agreed with the customer for the order.

outputParameters.name: ADID
outputParameters.description: Delivery address number used for the order.

outputParameters.name: PYNO
outputParameters.description: Payer number that will be invoiced for the order.

outputParameters.name: FILE
